Describe the diseases in a system

Source: R/inputs.R
cm_diseases.Rd

One row per disease: how common it is in the whole population. Rows about two or more diseases (associations, combinations, prevalences within subgroups) belong in cm_associations().

Usage

cm_diseases(
  disease,
  value,
  measure = "prevalence",
  label = NA_character_,
  time_horizon = NA_character_,
  reference_population = NA_character_,
  source = NA_character_,
  note = NA_character_,
  ...
)

Arguments

disease

Character vector of unique disease ids (no |, ; or :; "all" and "others" are reserved).

value

Numeric vector of disease occurrence values, interpreted according to measure.

measure

Character, one per disease (or recycled):

  • "prevalence": proportion of animals affected at a representative point in time (used as the probability directly).

  • "probability": probability of at least one case within time_horizon (used directly).

  • "incidence_rate": expected number of cases per animal within time_horizon (e.g. 0.48 for 48 cases per 100 lactations). Converted to a probability assuming Poisson-distributed events, 1 - exp(-value), as in Rasmussen et al. (2024), eq. 1.

label

Optional full names of the diseases (e.g. "lameness").

time_horizon

Character label of the period the probabilities refer to (e.g. "lactation", "year"). Probabilities, associations and impacts should all refer to the same period.

reference_population

Optional description of the population the values come from.

source, note

Optional citation and free-text note.

...

Not used (arguments of earlier versions give a message).

Value

A cm_diseases data frame with the converted probability in column prob and the inputs retained.

Examples

cm_diseases(c("SCK", "PTB"), c(0.4789, 0.1001),
            measure = c("incidence_rate", "prevalence"),
            label = c("subclinical ketosis", "paratuberculosis"),
            time_horizon = "lactation")
#>   disease      prob  value        measure               label time_horizon
#> 1     SCK 0.3805356 0.4789 incidence_rate subclinical ketosis    lactation
#> 2     PTB 0.1001000 0.1001     prevalence    paratuberculosis    lactation
#>   reference_population source note
#> 1                 <NA>   <NA> <NA>
#> 2                 <NA>   <NA> <NA>
